summary: Implemented grid-sampled patch iteration. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coordinates) pairs in the unpadded frame; set_rnd skips dunder attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NotImplementedError on missing len; PatchDataset docstring uses float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset), and tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_len). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Deviations: test_loading_array checks that each patch is its source plus one constant offset in [-1, 1] instead of literal values, because I could not compute the seeded values without running code; the multi-worker check compares coordinate sets and shift structure rather than exact values, since worker seeds differ. The GridPatchDataset and PatchIter docstring example outputs are hand-derived and unverified. Next step: run pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py and record the literal constants.
